# Generated by "make docs" from the code and the translation catalogs.
title: "Configuration"
weight: 20
---

Every key of the configuration file, the environment variable that overrides it and its default value. Values come, from the highest precedence to the lowest, from command line options, environment variables, the file and the defaults. Unknown keys are errors. The file deploy/config/greenlens.example.yaml lists every key, and api/config.schema.json describes them for editors.


## agent

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent.sample_interval` | `GREENLENS_AGENT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL` | duration | `1s` | How often energy is sampled, from 50ms to 60s. |
| `agent.data_dir` | `GREENLENS_AGENT_DATA_DIR` | string | empty | Directory of the database. Empty: /var/lib/greenlens for the system service, $XDG_DATA_HOME/greenlens for a user. |
| `agent.socket` | `GREENLENS_AGENT_SOCKET` | string | empty | Unix socket of the agent. Empty: /run/greenlens/greenlens.sock for the system service, $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/greenlens/greenlens.sock for a user. |
| `agent.host_root` | `GREENLENS_AGENT_HOST_ROOT` | string | `/` | Root of the host file system, such as /host in a container with the host root mounted there. |

## sources

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sources.auto` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_AUTO` | bool | `true` | Choose sources automatically. When false, only the sources named in sources.force are used. |
| `sources.disable` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_DISABLE` | list of strings | empty | Sources that are never used. |
| `sources.force` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_FORCE` | map of strings | empty | Source preferred for a domain (package, dram, gpu, psys, platform), such as `{package: perf_event}`. |
| `sources.rapl.min_interval` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_RAPL_MIN_INTERVAL` | duration | `50ms` | Shortest sampling interval accepted; raising it lowers the time resolution of the RAPL counters. |
| `sources.nvml.helper` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_NVML_HELPER` | string | empty | Path of greenlens-nvml, the helper that reads NVIDIA GPUs. Empty: next to greenlens, then /usr/libexec/greenlens and /usr/lib/greenlens. |
| `sources.estimate.idle_watts` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_ESTIMATE_IDLE_WATTS` | number | `0` | Power of the whole CPU at 0% utilization for the estimate model; 0 uses the embedded table. |
| `sources.estimate.full_watts` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_ESTIMATE_FULL_WATTS` | number | `0` | Power of the whole CPU at 100% utilization for the estimate model; 0 uses the embedded table. |
| `sources.estimate.exponent` | `GREENLENS_SOURCES_ESTIMATE_EXPONENT` | number | `1` | Exponent of the utilization in the estimate model; 1 is linear. |

## attribution

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attribution.idle_policy` | `GREENLENS_ATTRIBUTION_IDLE_POLICY` | string | `dynamic` | How idle energy is attributed: dynamic, proportional, full or wall. |
| `attribution.max_models_per_backend` | `GREENLENS_ATTRIBUTION_MAX_MODELS_PER_BACKEND` | integer | `50` | Most models tracked per backend; the energy of the others is reported together as 'other'. |
| `attribution.max_consumers` | `GREENLENS_ATTRIBUTION_MAX_CONSUMERS` | integer | `200` | Most consumers tracked by the proxy; the others are reported together as 'other'. |
| `attribution.regression_min_r2` | `GREENLENS_ATTRIBUTION_REGRESSION_MIN_R2` | number | `0.7` | Lowest R2 at which the energy per prompt token and per generated token, fitted over the last 24 hours, is reported. |

## backends

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backends` | - | list of objects | empty | Inference servers declared in the configuration. They keep their name across restarts and take precedence over discovered ones. |
| `backends[].name` | - | string | empty | Name of the backend in reports and metrics: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. |
| `backends[].kind` | - | string | empty | Engine of the backend, which selects how its tokens are read. |
| `backends[].endpoint` | - | string | empty | Base URL of the server, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000. |
| `backends[].process` | - | string | empty | File name of the executable, to find the processes of a process backend or of a server whose port is not visible. |

## discovery

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `discovery.enabled` | `GREENLENS_DISCOVERY_ENABLED` | bool | `true` | Look for known inference servers among the running processes. |
| `discovery.interval` | `GREENLENS_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL` | duration | `10s` | How often processes and listening ports are scanned, from 1s to 10m. |

## proxy

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `proxy.enabled` | `GREENLENS_PROXY_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | Run the proxy. |
| `proxy.listen` | `GREENLENS_PROXY_LISTEN` | string | `127.0.0.1:11435` | Address and port the proxy listens on. |
| `proxy.upstream` | `GREENLENS_PROXY_UPSTREAM` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Base URL of the server the proxy forwards to. |
| `proxy.per_request_energy_header` | `GREENLENS_PROXY_PER_REQUEST_ENERGY_HEADER` | bool | `false` | Add X-GreenLens-Energy-Joules to each response, as a trailer for streamed ones. |
| `proxy.consumer_header` | `GREENLENS_PROXY_CONSUMER_HEADER` | string | empty | Request header that tells consumers apart, such as Authorization; its value is kept only as an HMAC. |
| `proxy.consumer_aliases_file` | `GREENLENS_PROXY_CONSUMER_ALIASES_FILE` | string | empty | YAML file mapping consumer names to the SHA-256 of header values, written as sha256:&lt;hex&gt;. |

## server

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server.enabled` | `GREENLENS_SERVER_ENABLED` | bool | `true` | Serve the HTTP API and the graphical interface. |
| `server.listen` | `GREENLENS_SERVER_LISTEN` | string | `127.0.0.1:10060` | Address and port of the HTTP API. Listening beyond loopback needs at least one access token. |
| `server.tokens_file` | `GREENLENS_SERVER_TOKENS_FILE` | string | empty | File of access tokens, kept as argon2id hashes. Empty: tokens in the data directory. |
| `server.metrics_auth` | `GREENLENS_SERVER_METRICS_AUTH` | bool | `false` | Ask for an access token on /metrics too. |
| `server.tls.cert_file` | `GREENLENS_SERVER_TLS_CERT_FILE` | string | empty | Certificate chain in PEM. |
| `server.tls.key_file` | `GREENLENS_SERVER_TLS_KEY_FILE` | string | empty | Private key in PEM, readable only by the agent. |

## indicators

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `indicators.emission_factor_g_per_kwh` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_EMISSION_FACTOR_G_PER_KWH` | number or null | `null` | Grid emission factor in gCO2e/kWh. Null: FESEN 2024, 444 gCO2e/kWh. |
| `indicators.emission_factor_source` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_EMISSION_FACTOR_SOURCE` | string | empty | Where a configured emission factor comes from; required when the factor is set. |
| `indicators.hourly_profile_file` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_HOURLY_PROFILE_FILE` | string | empty | Absolute path of a CSV file with the grid intensity of each hour of the week (weekday,hour,g_co2e_per_kwh), which replaces the emission factor hour by hour. Empty: the factor applies to every hour. |
| `indicators.timezone` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_TIMEZONE` | string | empty | IANA time zone of the hourly profile and the tariff periods, such as America/Mexico_City. Empty: the time zone of the system. |
| `indicators.pue` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_PUE` | number | `1` | Power usage effectiveness of the facility; 1.0 means no overhead. |
| `indicators.wue_l_per_kwh` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_WUE_L_PER_KWH` | number or null | `null` | Water usage effectiveness in liters per kWh. Null: water is not reported. |
| `indicators.tariff.price_per_kwh` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_TARIFF_PRICE_PER_KWH` | number or null | `null` | Price of electricity per kWh. Null: cost is not reported. |
| `indicators.tariff.currency` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_TARIFF_CURRENCY` | string | `MXN` | ISO 4217 code of the currency of the tariff. |
| `indicators.tariff.periods` | - | list of objects | empty | Time-of-use prices. price_per_kwh applies outside them; without it, the periods must cover the whole week. |
| `indicators.tariff.periods[].days` | - | list of strings | empty | Weekdays of the period: sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri or sat. |
| `indicators.tariff.periods[].from` | - | string | empty | Local time the period starts, such as 18:00. |
| `indicators.tariff.periods[].to` | - | string | empty | Local time the period ends, later than from on the same day; 24:00 is the end of the day. |
| `indicators.tariff.periods[].price_per_kwh` | - | number | `0` | Price per kWh during the period, in the currency of the tariff. |
| `indicators.sci.functional_unit` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_SCI_FUNCTIONAL_UNIT` | string | `1k_generated_tokens` | Unit of the SCI: 1k_generated_tokens, request or consumer. |
| `indicators.sci.embodied.server_kgco2e` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_SCI_EMBODIED_SERVER_KGCO2E` | number or null | `null` | Embodied carbon of the server in kgCO2e, from the product carbon footprint of its maker. Null: not included. |
| `indicators.sci.embodied.gpu_kgco2e` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_SCI_EMBODIED_GPU_KGCO2E` | number or null | `null` | Embodied carbon of the GPUs in kgCO2e. Null: not included. |
| `indicators.sci.embodied.lifetime_years` | `GREENLENS_INDICATORS_SCI_EMBODIED_LIFETIME_YEARS` | number or null | `null` | Years of use of the hardware, over which its embodied carbon is spread. Required with embodied carbon. |

## retention

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `retention.raw` | `GREENLENS_RETENTION_RAW` | duration | `168h0m0s` | How long raw samples are kept. |
| `retention.rollup_1m` | `GREENLENS_RETENTION_ROLLUP_1M` | duration | `2160h0m0s` | How long one-minute rollups are kept. |
| `retention.rollup_1h` | `GREENLENS_RETENTION_ROLLUP_1H` | duration | `17520h0m0s` | How long one-hour rollups are kept. |

## logging

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `logging.level` | `GREENLENS_LOGGING_LEVEL` | string | `info` | Minimum level of the agent logs: debug, info, warn or error. |
| `logging.format` | `GREENLENS_LOGGING_FORMAT` | string | `json` | Format of the agent logs: json or text. |
